pages.text: A $(thing)Chaveta$() is the cutting tool used beside cured tobacco leaf in a crafting grid. The tool survives the recipe and takes durability damage. Better materials mainly give you more uses; the cut type is controlled by placement, not by tool tier.

Durability:$(br2)Stone: 131$(br)Copper: 180$(br)Iron: 250$(br)Gold: 32$(br)Diamond: 1,561$(br)Netherite: 2,031$(br2)Upgrade a Diamond Chaveta to Netherite with the normal Netherite Upgrade smithing template and a Netherite Ingot.
pages.title: Durability
